compiler_warning_review.detail: Review final candidate warnings, including MLX Metal C++17 extension and cmark/AppIntents metadata diagnostics observed during local compilation. Fix product-owned warnings or record approved, scoped upstream exceptions in Linear; do not silently suppress them.

gateway_contract_acceptance.detail: Existing independent validation recorded controlled failures in native token refresh/revoke, SSE expiry, controller lease renewal, JSONL writer isolation and restored tool projection. Active fixes must receive final-version independent contract and native journey acceptance; historical fixtures are not current-final evidence.

production_sign_in.detail: Native browser OAuth/PKCE is integrated; 57 focused tests and generic-device Release build passed. Actual main-site session compatibility and deployed native login/chat acceptance remain unverified.

account_deletion.detail: The related backend supports account registration, but the app only signs out and deletes sessions. Provide a real account-deletion flow and retention/deletion contract; do not substitute token revocation.

privacy_and_provider_review.detail: Confirm the deployed gateway/provider inventory, retention/deletion policy, consent behavior and App Privacy answers against the signed candidate.

signed_archive.detail: No Apple Distribution identity is currently available. The intended Developer Team, provisioning profile and validated distribution export are required.

app_store_metadata.detail: Create or verify the owned App Store Connect app, public support/privacy URLs, age rating, screenshots, pricing/export compliance and reviewer account; run fastlane precheck against actual metadata.

device_acceptance.detail: Verify production critical journeys on supported physical devices, accessibility sizes, VoiceOver, IPv6-only network and background/foreground recovery.

testflight_acceptance.detail: Distribute the signed immutable candidate to internal TestFlight, independently verify its gateway/session journeys and retain rollback evidence.
